executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote to cross-layer gate. Localize the failed operator, parameter, source file, or SACG edge; if the gap is within approved template metadata/binding repair bounds route to bounded_template_repair, otherwise raise stage_backtrack_request rather than using free-form RTL.
produces: SACG constraint references for every covered operator
executable_actions.rationale: Finalize the current candidate as a bounded operator-template coverage artifact by checking SACG references, selected template coverage, and template parameter/source binding using the registered acceptance checkers before cross-layer gate consumption.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the artifact in template_selection and regenerate the handoff package with missing SACG references or explicit blocker classification; do not rely on human memory or downstream inference to recover coverage evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: Package the ready coverage decision for template_selection.cross_layer_gate_engineer while preserving the no-free-form-RTL barrier and all model, shape, numeric, memory, runtime, deployment, and cross-layer references needed for the next gate.

observations: SACG memory shows no open backtrack_requests, open retry_requests, active contamination_barriers, or recent contamination barriers relevant to this template_selection coverage review.

The visible operator_sequence contains 9 decoder operators: rms_norm_1, self_attention, residual_add_1, rms_norm_2, mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, activation_mul, mlp_down_proj, and residual_add_2. The artifact reports coverage.required_ops=9, coverage.covered_ops=9, coverage.has_block_wrapper=true, and missing_ops=[].
The block wrapper is explicitly covered by selected template qwen2_block -> decoder_block from DecoderBlock.scala with role=block_wrapper and status=ready in parameter_bindings.

Every top-level decoder operator is bound to a selected trusted template: rms_norm_1 -> norm, self_attention -> attention, residual_add_1 -> residual, rms_norm_2 -> norm, mlp_gate_proj -> ffn, mlp_up_proj -> ffn, activation_mul -> elementwise, mlp_down_proj -> ffn, and residual_add_2 -> residual.

Required attention semantic coverage is explicitly expanded rather than hidden inside an unreviewed free-form RTL assumption: qkv_projection is covered, RoPE is covered, GQA head mapping is covered with num_q_heads=14, num_kv_heads=2, group_size=7, softmax is covered, output_projection is covered, and causal_mask is covered. KV cache is recorded as not_required, not missing.

selected_templates also include attention submodule templates softmax -> softmax from Softmax.scala and causal_mask -> mask from Mask.scala, supporting the self_attention coverage requirement in the stage gate policy.
required_adapters=[] and unsupported_bindings=[], so this candidate does not rely on explicit adapters or unsupported/free-form bindings to close coverage gaps.

Parameter binding evidence reports no missing_params and no legality_errors for the block wrapper, all top-level decoder operators, and attention submodules. Bound sources reference model, shape, numeric, architecture, memory, and board-related SACG constraints rather than implicit constructor defaults.

Template source/interface evidence reports pass for DecoderBlock.scala, Norm.scala, Attention.scala, Residual.scala, FFN.scala, Elementwise.scala, Softmax.scala, and Mask.scala, with source files present and no metadata/constructor required-parameter mismatches reported.

Checker evidence in the candidate artifact reports pass for operator_coverage_check, template_parameter_binding_check, template_source_and_interface_check, attention_semantic_expansion_check, and cross_layer_trace_check with no errors or warnings.

The cross_layer_trace reports present=true for constraint.numeric.policy, constraint.memory.board, constraint.runtime.board, constraint.deployment.board, and constraint.cross_layer.input_consistency, so template selection is tied to cross-layer facts beyond only model shape.

The artifact contains explicit forbidden_edits against closing missing template coverage with free-form RTL, relying on Chisel default constructor values when model/numeric/board values are available, or changing template internals, data order, memory layout, numeric policy, or board/runtime assumptions without approval.

Per stage_gate_policy, absent VCS/Verilator simulation, Vivado synthesis/implementation, generated accelerator code, runtime driver, board wrapper, full DDR/AXI integration, and later numeric/board bring-up evidence are not current-stage blockers and are not claimed as passed here.
proposed_actions: Promote the operator_template_coverage_review to template_selection.cross_layer_gate_engineer with the per-operator SACG constraint references preserved.

Archive or rerun the canonical stage acceptance checks under the requested names sacg_static_check, template_coverage_check, and template_binding_static_check if the pipeline requires exact checker-name evidence rather than the candidate artifact's equivalent checker names.

Downstream code generation and verification stages must preserve the selected template source bindings, parameter sources, and forbidden-edits barrier; any later attempt to close coverage through free-form RTL should trigger bounded template repair or backtrack rather than promotion.
output.summary: Coverage review is ready for cross-layer gate consumption: the candidate artifact covers the qwen2 block wrapper and all 9 decoder operators with trusted selected templates, expands required self-attention semantics, reports no missing_ops or required_adapters, and shows passing coverage, parameter binding, source/interface, attention semantic, and cross-layer trace checks. This is not a hardware or simulation pass claim.
